d:
Deni Avdija took over in Portland, scoring a team-high 28 points on 9-for-20 shooting with 4 threes, 6 assists, 3 rebounds and 4 steals, tying his career high in steals, as the Trail Blazers beat the Thunder, 118-108!
Jrue Holiday added 19 points on 5-for-12 shooting, including 5-for-8 from three. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led Oklahoma City with 31 points and 4 rebounds in the loss.
The Trail Blazers improve to 8-3, and the Thunder fall to 8-4.
